glosses: To endure without yielding; to withstand.

examples.text: The old oak tree abides the wind endlessly.

examples.text:

glosses: To wait in expectation.

glosses: To pause; to delay.

examples.text: The Dude abides.

examples.text: […]And shalt abide her judgment on it.
